name: regression-v1
purpose: Regression cases for the observed routing, name, join, context and date failures, plus the previously inspected held-out failures (now regression cases, not a generalization measure), and a 'fresh' split of new cases written before running them, for a small generalization check. Fixture cases run on evaluation/fixture_db.py (isolated SQLite copy of the schema). Never add these questions or reference queries to knowledge_base/.

turns: Create a donut chart for the operational volume of each hospital, based on the number of patients with a bill exceeding 30.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT d.hospital_branch, COUNT(DISTINCT b.patient_id) FROM billing AS b JOIN treatments AS t ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE b.amount > 30 GROUP BY d.hospital_branch
alternative_reference_sqls: SELECT d.hospital_branch, COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id) FROM billing AS b JOIN treatments AS t ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE b.amount > 30 GROUP BY d.hospital_branch

scenarios.notes: A data request despite the chart words. Distinct patients per branch overlap, so no donut; the reply must say why.
